_about: Hand-labelled ticket pairs for evaluating related-ticket matching. 'related' = an agent would want to see one when handling the other. Kept deliberately varied: paraphrases, different vocabulary for the same problem, topics absent from the knowledge base, and unrelated pairs that share generic words. The final related pair was added after an evaluation miss surfaced in the test suite (recorded so the set's history is honest).
